markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://www.levitate.ai/faqs#main-content)

# Frequently asked questions

General

## General questions

How is this different from Mailchimp, Constant Contact, or other mass blast email providers?

Email service providers like Mailchimp and Constant Contact are designed for a single purpose: sending mass-blast emails. Levitate is a relationship nurturing platform that includes marketing coaching, pre-written content templates, contact management features, AI-created content, automations, reminders, and more. Unlike mass blast email providers, emails sent through the Levitate platform use your every day email server (Gmail or Outlook) so emails look and feel like a one-to-one, personal email. This is one of the reasons why our customers’ emails average a 67% open rate compared to 20% using mass blast tools.

How is it different from my Agency Management System, Field Service Management System, Practice Management System or CRM?

Levitate complements (and in some cases, [integrates](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations) with) a number of CRMs, Agency Management Systems, Field Service Management and Practice Management Systems across various industries. While every management system is different, we find Levitate provides the most added value in the areas of content planning/marketing support, managing key facts and dates to help personalize contacts, and the ability to execute keep-in-touch email marketing campaigns that flow through your everyday email server--including robust reporting and analytics. Check out our [Features](https://www.levitate.ai/features) page for a full list of ways we can add value to your business alongside your management system.

Are there any contracts?

Levitate subscriptions have a one-year commitment. Levitate is an annual subscription service, and you can choose not to renew at your next annual renewal date at any time. You will then have access to the platform for the remainder of the 12 month billing cycle that you originally purchased but not have your account renewed for the following year.

How will I get billed?

Levitate plans are billed annually based on when you signed up for the service. If you joined on August 1st, you will be billed again on August 1st of the following year.

Is this going to be difficult for me to get set up and my team to be trained?

Nope. As soon as you join us, you’ll be assigned to a dedicated Success Specialist who will schedule your onboarding, help you import your contacts, craft your content strategy, and train anyone on your team who wants to use the platform. We’ll be there every step of the way to answer any questions you may have.

How much does Levitate cost?

Levitate is one plan with every feature included, built and priced for small businesses. Website Prestige, ads and handwritten cards (priced per card) are optional add-ons, and new customers may get first-year pricing. [Book a demo](https://www.levitate.ai/contact) and we'll give you an exact quote on the call.

What does the pricing look like for a business with more than 5 users?

We offer pricing plans that can be customized for your business. [Schedule a demo](https://www.levitate.ai/contact) with one of our team members and we’ll come up with a plan suited to your needs.

General

## How Levitate works

How do I upload my new contacts?

Check out [this tutorial](https://help.levitate.ai/en/articles/3412543-how-to-create-multiple-contacts-at-once) for a quick overview. If you’re a new client, your Success Specialist will walk you through this during our onboarding process as well.

If you’re worried about uncategorized contacts, don’t be -- our Contact Tagging Game makes it easy (and yes, fun!) to build an organized list, one swipe at a time.

What happens to my contacts once I upload them? Are they secure?

Levitate never sells or otherwise transfers your data to any outside parties. Your security is one of our top concerns. Please review our [Privacy Policy](https://www.levitate.ai/privacy-policy) and [Terms of Service](https://www.levitate.ai/terms-of-service) for details.

Can I use Levitate to send text messages to my contacts?

Yes! You can text via a custom phone number through Levitate and set up automations (like birthday wishes or renewal reminders) to really wow your clients. With texting (and email) we like quality over quantity so bulk texting is not recommended.

Will I get to approve or edit my email before it is sent?

In most cases, our customers schedule and send their own emails within the platform. We also have a “Review and Approve” feature that allows your Success Specialist to send you proposed email campaigns to send to some or all of your contacts. You can edit, approve, or reject any campaign that is recommended directly from your mobile device or desktop.

Do I have to create my own content?

While many of our customers write their own content, all Levitate subscriptions include access to our pre-written email and social media template library, full of industry-specific award-winning content that you can edit and send. Our plans also include four completely customized templates annually. Plus, certain Levitate plans give you unlimited use of our AI content creation feature to write new content, rewrite existing content, or translate to another language in seconds. Whether it’s a local market update tailored to your community or a custom prospect drip campaign designed to nurture new leads, we’ve got you covered.

Can I add photos, links, or attachments to my emails?

Yes. While our platform allows for all of these, your Success Specialist will teach you how to use these strategically in order to be effective at authentic outreach. The beauty of Levitate is that our emails feel like personal, one-to-one emails -- so we often encourage our clients to veer away from graphics or link-heavy content that comes across as advertising.

Can I send from multiple email addresses with my Levitate account?

If you want to send emails from multiple email addresses in Levitate, you would need to create a new user for each additional email address. All of our plans include up to 5 users, so you would simply need to use one of those “seats” included with your plan to accomplish this.

General

## AI Solutions

Is this just Levitate's product?

No. We build custom apps and tools that go beyond Levitate's core product, designed around how your business actually works. Levitate runs quietly as the engine behind some of it.

Will this replace my team or make my business feel less personal?

No, and that's the whole point. We use AI for the manual tasks and spreadsheet work, not the relationships. When the busywork stops eating your week, you get more time for the human connection your clients and prospects actually want. Technology should deepen those connections, not replace them.

How long does it take?

We work in short sprints and aim to get something useful in your hands in weeks, not months. We start with one quick win rather than a sprawling project.

Do I need to be technical?

Not at all. You bring the knowledge of your business. We handle all of the AI and the building. If a conversation ever starts to sound like jargon, that's on us to fix.

What does it cost?

Lightweight and custom, not another expensive enterprise platform. We'll walk through the specifics on our call, once we understand what you actually need.

Do I own my IP?

Yes. You keep your knowledge files and data, while anything built from the core Levitate code stays on our servers.

Is this a CRM?

It can be, but many clients put their Levitate AI Solution alongside their CRM, so you don't have to rip and replace.

Do you use offshore talent?

No. Most of the people involved in your build are in Raleigh, NC, with some teammates in Toronto and other US cities.

Can it connect to my systems?

Usually, as long as they have an API or MCP we can connect with. Not sure? We'll help you find out during our conversation.

Is it secure?

Yes. We're SOC 2 Type II, committed to SEC Regulation S-P and HIPAA-enabled, so you can use AI without the fear of putting your data at risk.

Can I just DIY it?

Yes, but then you'll be managing enterprise software, with security, uptime and more to take care of on top of your day job.

Features

## Keep in Touch

Isn't this just a reminder?

The cadence is. The agent goes further: it decides who is most worth contacting right now, explains why, and drafts the message.

Where does the online research come from?

Public sources only, such as news articles, press releases, company websites, and professional profiles, found using the name and company already on the contact. There are no social accounts to connect.

Will it send anything on its own?

No. There is no bulk option, and every suggested message waits for you to review, edit, and send it yourself.

Will it keep suggesting someone I just called?

No. Once you reach out, it pauses suggestions for that person for a while.

Can my whole team use it?

Yes. Admins can set up jobs across the account, and each person can create their own. People see the suggestions for the contacts they own.

Does it cost extra?

No. Keep in Touch is included with Levitate. Ask your Success Specialist to turn on the agent.

Features

## Exec Assistants

Will it send an email without me?

No. Every draft waits for you.

Which email providers work?

Accounts connected through Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, or Microsoft 365.

Does my team see my priorities?

No. Each person configures their own.

What if it flags the wrong things?

Adjust your priorities any time. Changes apply to new mail immediately.

Does it read everything in my inbox?

It looks for what matches the priorities you set and filters out what you tell it to ignore. What each AI feature can reach is covered on our [AI page](https://www.levitate.ai/features/ai).

Features

## Contacts & Key Facts

Do I have to replace my CRM or management system?

No. Levitate connects to it and keeps contacts in sync, with your existing system staying the source of truth for core details. Levitate adds the key facts, history, and engagement that system does not track.

My contacts are a mess. Do I need to clean them up first?

No. Import what you have, merge duplicates as they surface, and use the Tagging Game to sort the rest over time. Your Success Specialist helps with setup.

Can I keep some contacts private?

Yes. Any contact can be visible to the whole team or only to its owner and connections, and you can change it for one contact or many at once.

Can I track something specific to my business?

Yes. Beyond the standard key facts and tags, your Success Specialist can set up custom fields for anything your business needs to record.

How does it know whether someone is engaged?

Every email sent through Levitate is tracked, and a color-coded status on each contact shows how recently you connected.

Features

## Emails

Will this hurt my email deliverability?

No, and it usually helps. Levitate sends through your own account rather than a shared marketing server, so your messages carry your domain's reputation rather than someone else's. Sending volume stays within the limits your provider sets.

Is this compliant?

Levitate supports the disclosures and approval workflows regulated industries need, including compliance review before a send. Financial services accounts can archive text messages as well.

Features

## Automations

Do automated emails come from me?

Yes. They send from your own inbox, or a teammate's, never from a marketing server.

Can AI write the emails?

Yes. Tell an AI email step what to say, and it writes a personal email for each person when it sends. Because those emails send automatically, be specific, and test on a small group first.

What if someone's situation changes?

Automations send people down different paths based on what they do, and stop when the reason for them goes away.

Will clients get messages on holidays?

Only the ones that should go out, like birthday wishes. Everything else waits.

Features

## Content

Who writes Levitate's content?

Our in-house content team, with writers who specialize in the industries we serve. Every piece is reviewed and updated regularly.

Won't my clients get the same email as everyone else's clients?

Your clients see a message from you, sent from your own inbox, filled in with details about them. You can personalize any piece by hand or have Lev rewrite it in your own style.

Can I use my own content?

Absolutely. Write from scratch, save your own templates, or ask Lev to help you draft.

Does content cost extra?

No. The library, the calendar, your Success Specialist, and Lev are all included with Levitate.

Features

## Texting

Can I use the business number I already have?

Often, yes. Levitate checks whether your existing number can be used for texting. If it can't, we set you up with a new local one.

Why do I need to register to text?

Carriers require businesses to register before sending texts, and unregistered messages are often blocked. Levitate walks you through it so your texts actually arrive.

Will clients see who else received a campaign text?

No. Every contact gets their own separate message, and replies come back to you privately.

Can my whole team use the same number?

Yes. Everyone on your account can text from a shared number and see the same conversations.

What happens when someone wants to stop receiving texts?

You can opt contacts out individually or in bulk, and Levitate keeps track so they don't hear from you again.

Features

## Handwritten Cards

Do I have to write each one?

No. Write one message and send it to as many people as you like, start from the card library, or have Lev draft it for you.

Can I send cards automatically?

Yes. Add a card as a step in any automation, and it will send on birthdays, anniversaries, or any other date in your data.

Can I add my logo?

Yes. You can add your logo to your cards.

How are cards mailed?

Through USPS, with a Forever Stamp on every envelope.

How much do cards cost?

Cards are $4 each, including the envelope and postage.

Features

## Data Boards

Which boards can I use?

Opportunity and Meetings boards work for any business. Policy, Matter, Donation and Service Job boards are built for their industries. Your Success Specialist turns on the ones you need.

Do I have to enter everything by hand?

No. Data can come in from the systems you already use, or from a spreadsheet import.

Can I export board data?

Yes. Export a whole board or just the rows you select to a spreadsheet.

Can my data trigger automations?

Yes. New opportunities, policies, matters and donations can each start one.

Can I see how my pipeline is doing?

Yes. Advanced Reporting shows summary metrics, a drill-down into each number and an activity log, and you can share a saved view with your team.

Features

## Files

What makes it secure?

Files are protected with 256-bit AES encryption, and file sharing is covered by our SOC 2 compliance.

Do my clients need an account or password?

No. They click the link and upload from any device.

How long do upload links last?

Thirty days. An upload link in your email signature doesn't expire.

What can clients upload?

PDFs, Word and Excel files, and JPG or PNG images.

Does AI read my clients' documents?

Levitate strips out identifying information before the AI sorts a document, so it can label what came in without seeing your clients' personal details.

Can financial advisors use file requests?

File requests are off for financial accounts, because uploads don't pass through your email archive. Your Success Specialist can walk you through other ways to share documents securely.

Features

## Social Media

Which platforms does Levitate post to?

Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.

Do I have to write posts myself?

No. Use the library, have Lev write one, or turn your best reviews into posts.

Will posts look like my brand?

Yes. Your colors, fonts and logo carry across automatically once your brand is set up.

Can I review posts before they go out?

Always. Nothing posts without approval, and posts can go through a compliance review first.

Do I need to pay for images?

No. Royalty-free images are included, and AI can create custom ones.

Features

## Blogs

Do I need a Levitate website?

No. Publish to your Levitate site or a Levitate-hosted blog, or copy any post into your own site.

How long are the posts?

Roughly 850 to 1,000 words, with an FAQ section and an image.

Can I edit a post before it goes live?

Yes. Edit anything, preview it, then schedule it.

Will blogging help me show up in search?

Fresh, useful content gives Google and AI tools more reasons to find you. Nobody can guarantee rankings, but a blog that's gone quiet won't help.

Can I write posts from my AI assistant?

Yes. Through the Levitate MCP server, you can search, draft, update, schedule and cancel posts from any MCP-compatible assistant.

Features

## Google Reviews

What do I need to get started?

A Google Business Profile, and access to it as an owner, manager or admin. We'll help you connect it.

How will I know when I get a new review?

New reviews show up on your dashboard, and admins get an email digest.

Can I manage more than one location?

Yes. Connect every profile you manage, and each review shows which location it's for.

Can my reviews show up on my website?

Yes. Your Levitate website can display your Google reviews.

Can I ask for reviews in person?

Yes. Share your satisfaction survey with a QR code at your office or on a printed card.

Features

## Websites

Is the website really free?

Yes. When you buy the Relationship Intelligence Platform, there's no extra charge for your website for as long as you're a customer.

Will my site look like everyone else's?

No. Your site is built on your brand, with copy written for your business from a short intake.

Will my site show up in AI answers?

Every site is built so Google and AI tools can read and understand your business, with answer-first pages, FAQ and local business schema, team bios and credentials, and an llms.txt file that points AI assistants to your content. No one can guarantee a spot in AI answers, but these basics make your business easier to find and cite. Prestige adds ongoing work aimed at getting you cited more often.

Can I use my own domain?

Yes. Your site runs on your own domain.

What's the difference with Prestige?

Prestige adds a designer, a larger custom site, custom content, and a team that keeps improving your results in search and AI search.

Can I start with the free site and upgrade later?

Yes. Upgrade to Prestige whenever you're ready.

Who writes the copy?

We do, from a short intake about your business, written for the searches your clients make.

Features

## Ads

How much do I spend on ads?

You set your budget, and it goes directly to Google or Meta. Our ads team's management is a flat monthly fee.

Do you take a cut of my ad spend?

No. Your ad budget goes to Google and Meta, not to us.

Who runs my ads?

A dedicated Levitate ads team handles strategy, setup and ongoing optimization.

Can I change my budget?

Yes. Raise it, lower it or pause it whenever you need to.

Does my business qualify for Local Services Ads?

Google decides which business types and areas are eligible. We'll tell you if yours qualifies.

Do I need a Levitate plan?

Yes. Ads are an add-on to your Levitate plan, so they work alongside everything else we do for you.

Features

## Surveys

What kinds of surveys can I send?

Satisfaction surveys, NPS surveys, custom surveys and intake forms. Event registration and donation forms have their own pages.

Can clients upload documents in a survey?

Yes. Add a file upload question to any survey.

Can I brand my surveys?

Yes. Add your logo, colors and fonts so every survey looks like it came from you.

Can I build a survey with AI?

Yes. Through the Levitate MCP server, a connected AI assistant can build a complete survey for you, including show-and-hide logic.

Can a survey response start an automation?

Yes. Submitting a survey can enroll the respondent in an automation right away.

Features

## Events

Can I charge for events?

Yes. Connect your Stripe account and sell tickets at whatever price levels you need.

Can I run free events too?

Yes. Free events work the same way, just without the payment step.

Can I put my events on my website?

Yes. Embed your events landing page on your site, or share it as a link.

How does check-in work?

Check registrants in from the event in Levitate, and each one is tagged automatically so you can follow up with attendees.

Can I export my registration list?

Yes. Exports include each registrant's details and what they paid.

Features

## Meeting Booking

Does it work with my calendar?

Yes. Connect your Google or Microsoft calendar, and your booking page only offers times you're actually free.

Do online meetings get a video link?

Yes. Each Google Meet or Microsoft Teams booking gets its own link automatically.

Can clients reschedule or cancel?

Yes. Their confirmation includes reschedule and cancel links, and cancelling stops any reminders.

Can I limit how many meetings get booked?

Yes. Set limits per day or month and how far out people can book.

Can I brand my booking page?

Yes. Add your logo so every booking page looks like yours.

Features

## Reporting and Analytics

What does Levitate report on?

Emails, texts, automations, social posts, blogs, Google reviews, surveys, events, ads, your Levitate website and your data boards.

Can I share reports with my team?

Yes. Save a filtered view and send the link to anyone with access.

Can I export my data?

Yes. Most reports export to a spreadsheet.

Does it work with Google Analytics?

Your Levitate website tracks visitors on its own, and you can also send that data to your own Google Analytics 4 property.

Can I control who sees reports?

Yes. Admins choose which user groups can view reporting for features like automations, handwritten cards and social posts.

Features

## AI

Is my client data used to train AI models?

No. Levitate does not share your data with model providers for training, and their current terms prevent them from using it to improve their models.

Can the AI send something without me seeing it?

Only if you set it up that way. AI drafts wait for you, and hands-off features only run once you turn them on.

Does this work with my compliance requirements?

Yes. Archiving integrations, Compliance Flow, and broker-dealer pre-approval all continue to apply.

What does it cost?

Nothing extra, aside from a monthly allowance on AI Email Campaigns.

How do I turn it on?

Your Success Specialist enables the features you want.

Which AI models does Levitate use?

Disclosed on our [underlying AI model providers page](https://www.levitate.ai/underlying-ai-model-providers).

Features

## Your Success Specialist

Is a Success Specialist included in every plan?

Yes. Every Levitate account is paired with a dedicated Success Specialist, backed by our award-winning support team, at no extra cost.

How often will we meet?

You'll meet for onboarding and training, then every quarter to plan and review results. In between, your Specialist is a message away.

Will my Specialist help with content?

Yes. They build custom templates for you and can draft campaigns for you to approve, edit or reject from your phone. The industry library and Levitate's AI cover everything else.

Do I have to set up automations and AI myself?

No. Your Specialist sets up the automations that matter most and turns on the AI features you want.

Features

## Donations

How do online donations work?

Connect your Stripe account and gifts made through your Levitate donation form go straight to you.

Can donors give monthly?

Yes. Donors can give one time, monthly or yearly, all from the same form.

Can I bring in past donations?

Yes. Import them from a spreadsheet, and undo an import if something looks off.

Can donors give anonymously?

Yes. Anonymous gifts show as "Anonymous" on your board and reports, and only an email is collected for the receipt.

Can I track in-kind gifts?

Yes. Log in-kind donations with a description alongside every other gift.

Features

## Volunteer Management

Can volunteers sign up online?

Yes. Share a signup form and volunteers pick the activities and shifts that work for them.

How does check-in work?

Use the day-of roster to check volunteers in as they arrive.

Can I see volunteer activity in reports?

Yes. Reporting covers all your volunteer activities in one place.

Industries

## Insurance

Does Levitate work with my agency management system?

Yes. Levitate connects to Applied Epic, EZLynx, HawkSoft, AMS360, QQCatalyst and more. Your Success Specialist sets up the connection with you.

My management system already sends emails. Why would I need Levitate?

Your system sends the same notice to everyone. Levitate sends personal emails from your own inbox, about each client's actual policies, timed by their renewal dates.

Can my CSRs and producers send the outreach?

Yes. Each renewal email can send from the policy owner, the CSR or the producer, so clients hear from the person they know.

What happens if a client cancels mid-renewal?

The renewal sequence stops automatically, so nobody gets a reminder for coverage they no longer have.

Do you have social posts written for insurance?

Yes. The content library includes posts written for insurance agencies, organized by topic and season. Our content team also writes custom posts for your agency, and you can make your own with AI and your media library.

Industries

## Financial

Are Levitate emails archived?

Yes. Emails send from your own email account, so they follow your existing archiving setup, like Smarsh or Global Relay.

Can my compliance team review content first?

Yes. Blog posts and social posts can go to your compliance officer for approval before they publish, and required broker-dealer disclosures can be added to posts automatically.

Has my broker-dealer approved Levitate?

More than 40 broker-dealers have approved Levitate for their advisors' use.

Can I text clients?

Yes. Every text creates an email record, so texts are archived through your existing provider, like Smarsh or Global Relay, along with your email.

Does Levitate work with my AI assistant?

Yes. If your firm already uses an AI assistant, the Levitate MCP server connects it to your Levitate data. That routes data through your own AI account, so check with your compliance team first.

Is my clients' data secure?

Yes. Levitate is SOC 2 compliant, and our Trust Center shows our security controls. Due diligence questionnaires go to security@levitateapp.com.

Industries

## Legal

My practice runs on referrals. Why do I need marketing?

Because a referral now ends with a Google search. Before a referred client calls, they check your reviews and your website. Levitate keeps both strong and keeps your referral sources warm.

Does Levitate work with my practice management software?

Yes. Matter Boards bring in matters from Clio, MyCase and PracticePanther, and Levitate also connects with CasePeer to keep your clients and case details current.

Can you run our Google Local Service Ads?

Yes. Our dedicated ads team runs them for a flat monthly fee, and your ad budget goes to Google. They're available for eligible practice areas and locations.

Can we post to LinkedIn?

Yes. Levitate schedules posts to LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, and you can mention referral partners and organizations in each one.

Industries

## Accounting

We already have a client portal. Why do we need this?

Clients don't log into portals. A link they can open on their phone with no password gets documents back faster, and Levitate handles the reminders and the relationship around it.

What happens after tax season?

Keep in Touch, a content library written for accounting firms, and your Success Specialist keep you in front of clients the rest of the year, so you're not starting cold every January.

Can our whole firm use it?

Yes. User groups control what each person can see and do, and shared booking links and assigned tasks keep the work moving.

Can Levitate post to social for our firm?

Yes. Schedule posts to Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn from a library written for accounting firms. Our content team writes custom posts for your firm, and you can make your own with AI and your media library, like a quick post about a tax change your clients need to know.

Industries

## Nonprofit

We already have a donor database. Why would we need Levitate?

Your database records the gift. Levitate uses that giving history to decide who hears from you, when, and what you say, so the next ask is specific instead of generic.

Does Levitate work with our donor database?

Yes. Bloomerang connects directly, bringing in your constituents, households and giving history. You can also import donations from a spreadsheet.

Can we send year-end tax letters?

Yes. Generate them for one donor or everyone at once, for any date range.

Is there content written for nonprofits?

Yes. You get a library of nonprofit emails and social posts, plus 40 custom pieces of content a year from our in-house content team.

Can we thank sponsors on social?

Yes. Mention businesses and people in posts on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn, and preview how each mention will look before it publishes.

Industries

## Real Estate

My sphere already knows me. Why do I need this?

Knowing you isn't the same as thinking of you when they need an agent. Levitate keeps you present between transactions, so you're the first name that comes to mind and the one they pass along.

Does Levitate work for commercial brokers?

Yes. Tag contacts by tenant, landlord, investor or property type, track dates like lease starts, and send content written for commercial real estate.

Will my emails look like marketing?

No. Levitate sends through your own Gmail or Outlook account, so messages arrive like a real email from you and replies come back to your inbox.

Can I use Levitate from my phone?

Yes. The mobile app lets you text clients, add notes and set reminders on the go, and the Gmail add-on and Outlook plugin bring Levitate into your inbox.

Does Levitate work with Zillow, realtor.com and Follow Up Boss?

Yes. Levitate integrates with all three, so the contacts and leads you already have stay current without anyone re-typing them.

Can I post to Instagram and Facebook from Levitate?

Yes. Schedule posts to Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn, mention other accounts, and preview each post before it publishes.

Industries

## Mortgage

Borrowers just shop for the lowest rate. Why would this help?

Strangers shop rate. Past borrowers and referrals start with trust. Levitate keeps you in front of the people most likely to come back or send someone your way.

Can I stay in touch with referral partners, not just borrowers?

Yes. Tag agents, planners and builders, set a cadence for each, and send them updates and content they can share.

Can we add our NMLS number and disclosures?

Yes. Admins can set an account-wide signature and disclaimer so everything your team posts stays consistent.

Can I post when rates move?

Yes. Describe the update and Levitate writes the post and creates the image, then offers to turn the same idea into an email.

Industries

## Home Services

I need more calls, not more software. Is this for me?

Yes. Levitate starts with getting your phone to ring, through ads our team runs and reviews that win the click, then turns those customers into repeat business.

Do you run our ads?

Yes. Our dedicated ads team runs Google Local Service Ads and Facebook ads for a flat monthly fee. Your ad budget goes to Google and Meta, not to us. Google Local Service Ads are available for eligible businesses and areas.

Does Levitate work with my field service software?

Yes. The Service Job Board brings in your jobs, and your Success Specialist sets up the connection with you.

Can we text customers from Levitate?

Yes. Text one customer or a whole list from a shared business number, and attach estimates, photos and documents.

When should we ask for reviews?

Right after the job, while the customer is happy. Levitate can send the request automatically once the work is done.

Who writes our content?

Your Success Specialist and our content team, with blog posts written specifically for your business.

We don't have time to post. Can Levitate help?

Yes. You get ready-to-post content written for home services with your branding already on it, plus custom posts from our content team, and you schedule weeks at a time. Your Success Specialist helps plan the calendar.

Industries

## Other industries

Will posts look like they came from my business?

Yes. Levitate applies your colors, fonts and style to every post, and adds your logo when a template has no spot for it.

Industries

## Health

Is Levitate HIPAA-enabled?

Yes. Levitate is HIPAA-enabled, and your Success Specialist sets up your account with that in mind.

Do you have social posts written for chiropractic?

Yes. The library includes care tips, stretches and patient education posts. Our content team writes custom posts for your practice, and you can make your own with AI and your media library.

Ask Lev
